{{Quote|I've been assigned to Dromund Kaas for the past six months, and the galaxy is changing quickly.|Lieutenant Mallohe speaking of her time spent on Dromund Kaas|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Mallohe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which saw the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] pitted against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], Mallohe had been stationed on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] for six [[Time/Legends|months]], at which [[Time/Legends|time]] she was assigned to prepare encoded reports on recent Cold War conflicts for a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Kras]]. Kras wanted Mallohe to send him an Imperial individual who had been part of the recent fighting so that he could interview the individual inside the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel's]] [[Sith Sanctum]] in [[Kaas City]], the capital of Dromund Kaas. After she completed the reports, Lieutenant Mallohe met with an individual who had been involved in a [[Attack on the Brentaal Star|attack]] made by the Imperial [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]'' on the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]''. The individual took Mallohe's reports to Lord Kras and was interviewed by him.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Please make sure that these documents get to Lord Kras in the Citadel in a timely fashion.|Lieutenant Mallohe to an individual affiliated with the Empire|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:LieutenantMallohe2-TOR.png|thumb|left|100px|Mallohe in Kaas City's spaceport]]
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Mallohe served in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At one point in her career, Mallohe was assigned to serve on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the Sith Empire.<ref name="TOR" />

Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Mallohe had attained the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and had served for six [[Time/Legends|months]] on the Sith capital world. Unrest had brewed during that time between the Empire and the Republic, and many skirmishes were fought between the two sides. However, with her position being on Dromund Kaas, Lieutenant Mallohe did not take part in the combat.<ref name="TOR" />

In response to the fighting, a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Kras]] ordered Lieutenant Mallohe to produce coded reports that detailed the events of the skirmishes. Mallohe aided Kras in his preparations for a meeting with the Imperial [[Unidentified Minister of War (Sith Empire)|Minister]] [[Minister of War (Sith Empire)|of War]] who would be presented with recommendations from the Sith Lord. Mallohe was also instructed to send an individual who had been involved in the recent fighting to the [[Sith Sanctum]] of the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]], a large [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] in the center of Dromund Kaas's capital, [[Kaas City]]. There Lord Kras could interview the combatants and obtain firsthand information on the battles with the Republic. After she completed the reports, Lieutenant Mallohe waited for recent combatants to arrive at [[Dromund Kaas spaceport|Kaas City's spaceport]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Eventually, an individual affiliated with the Empire arrived who had taken part in a recent [[Attack on the Brentaal Star|battle]]<ref name="TOR" /> where the Imperial [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]'' attacked and boarded the Republic [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]''.<ref name="Black Talon">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Black Talon}}</ref> Mallohe presented the order to the individual, who accepted the assignment, took the reports to Lord Kras, and was interviewed by him.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It is only with the insight and the wisdom of the Sith that we can hope to win this war and conquer the hated Republic forever.|Lieutenant Mallohe on the war between the Empire and the Galactic Republic|<ref name="TOR" />}}
As a Sith military officer, Lieutenant Mallohe had experienced the nature of members of the Sith so that she treated them with respect&mdash;something which she advised other non-Sith to do as well. She also viewed the Sith as the sole way to defeat the Galactic Republic, which Mallohe viewed with hatred. The lieutenant had sufficient skills to write reports on combat operations fought between the Empire and the Galactic Republic. Mallohe had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and was dark-skinned. She carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and wore the uniform of a Sith military officer.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Mallohe first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online roleplaying game|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game, Mallohe is featured on Dromund Kaas, the Sith capital planet, in the Kaas City spaceport. She gives a quest to Imperial players who completed "The Black Talon,"<ref name="TOR" /> the first multiplayer flashpoint mission for Imperial players in the game. In the flashpoint, the players are assigned to capture or kill an individual codenamed "[[The General]]" who had defected from the Empire to give military secrets to the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Black Talon" /> The quest requires the player to take a coded message and report on the battle to Lord Kras, a Sith Lord who is located in Kaas City's Imperial Citadel, in an area of the fortress known as the Sith Sanctum. The quest is available to all of the Imperial classes and has some differences in dialogue from class to class. Also, the quest does not have any effect on the player character's [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] alignment. While the player does not have to meet with Mallohe and can refuse the quest, this article is written with the assumption that at least one of the four Imperial characters speaks with Lieutenant Mallohe and delivers her reports to Lord Kras. The player is also not required to give an interview to complete the quest and can refuse to do anything with Lord Kras other than present the reports.<ref name="TOR" />
